supported_scope: The Plans page exposes model-level baseline quota consumption in Settings; it does not establish task-level usage or charges.
unestablished_scope: Conversion between quota consumption and monetary cost
required_setup: Inspect App Settings for the documented aggregate quota view; retain unavailable task-level measurements as unavailable.
constraints: Quota is capacity-dependent and is not a token counter or a task invoice.
gap_reason: The documented quota view is across models, not an attributable per-task usage or charge measurement. CLI /usage and headless metrics cannot be transferred to this App baseline.
